edits.old: Then the system raises an incident
edits.new:
Then the system raises an incident

  Scenario: AC12 Role without the Treatment and offer right (exception X10)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns no Treatment and offer right for the officer's role
    When the officer opens the credit approval pack or records a result for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    Then the request is refused with message MSG-P4-002 before any read or write
    Then the treatment does not change

  Scenario: AC13 NLEADS decision read only through the source-data contract (BR4)
    Given NLEADS has no interface to the platform
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns the NLEADS decision for reference "NL-SYN-000614"
    When the officer records reference "NL-SYN-000614" with result "APPROVED" for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    Then the decision is read only through the rwb-source-data contract over v_ace_credit_decision
    Then no call to NLEADS is made

  Scenario: AC14 Pack composed at request time (BR11)
    When the officer opens the credit approval pack for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    Then the pack is composed at request time from the rwb-source-data, rwb-treatment, rwb-document, rwb-access and rwb-case contracts
    Then no row of case, treatment, account or document is written to rwb_integration

  Scenario: AC15 Treatment and route state not written here (BR12)
    When the officer records result "APPROVED" with reference "NL-SYN-000615" for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    Then the operation writes no treatment column and no treatment state
    Then the operation writes no route state and no queue entry

  Scenario: AC16 Pack reached only through the composite route (BR13)
    When the browser calls the pack operation directly and not through the gateway-bff composite route of SCR-14
    Then the call is refused and no pack data is returned
